self_build.status: Built from this repository on an 8x RTX PRO 6000 (SM120) host and validated by serving the full checkpoint in the measured configuration.
self_build.engine_image: Built from the pinned fork commit with vllm/docker/Dockerfile (target vllm-openai). All inputs are public: the fork source in this repository, pytorch/manylinux2_28-builder, nvidia/cuda, PyPI/PyTorch/FlashInfer wheels.
self_build.ext_image: Built by docker/Dockerfile.vllm-ext: the fork-compiled package tree plus a DeepGEMM _C rebuilt from https://github.com/vllm-project/DeepGEMM.git at a6bbb8000161c0dc3a85a0300a905f76898a7913 with the SM120 page-32 gates applied, keeping the stock extension as _C*.so.before-page32.
self_build.max_jobs: Host core count by default; the fork Dockerfile's max_jobs=2 serializes the ~410-target CUDA compile.
self_build.version_tag_note: The fork carries no git tags, so the build context is a tagged synthetic history of the pinned tree and setuptools_scm resolves the wheel version from that tag.
self_build.overlay: Dockerfile.vllm copies the pinned source tree and fills compiled artifacts from the extension image, then applies and verifies the three FlashInfer patches.
self_build.image_id_caveat: These IDs identify the build recorded above and are not stable across rebuilds: apt packages and several pip dependencies resolve at build time, so a clean-clone rebuild of the same commit produced different IDs of identical size. Use the image checks and the serving validation, not the ID, to confirm a build.
self_build.clean_clone_build: Verified: git clone --recursive of the published repository followed by MAX_JOBS=64 STEPS=all ./docker-build-vllm.sh on a host with no build cache and no pre-built prerequisite image produced image IDs 0d1c64b32765 / 7316166ce7c5 / dc9bc30a45d4. The engine image passed the image checks, reached Application startup complete, passed 11/11 API smoke tests and reproduced 9/10 exact plus 5/5 retrieval.
self_build.rebuild_note: The fork main was force-updated to 005b0af0d996d354dde582152909be96f7feac07 after the first build. That revision has the same tree (803434a5702fa871123b1ec370b6e96c47d00c2e) as the previously pinned 4980e062, so the compiled content is unchanged. All three images were rebuilt at the new pin (16 minutes with MAX_JOBS=64) and the engine image re-validated.
validation: Overlay verification baked into the image passes: import resolution, fork custom ops (vocab_parallel_embedding), tuned SM120 kernels, kernel-config knob.
DeepGEMM page-32 gates present in the compiled extension, identified by the stringized DG_HOST_ASSERT expression; the stock extension is retained as the .before-page32 backup.
All three FlashInfer SM120 patches verified in place on FlashInfer 0.6.18.post1.

Serving the full checkpoint (TP8, DSpark K3, FULL_DECODE_ONLY graphs, 1M context, block 64, linear_backend flashinfer_b12x, MoE alignment 64) reaches Application startup complete with CUDA graph capture on every TP rank.
Correctness battery: 9/10 exact-answer and 5/5 positional retrieval, with the same reverse-answer failure the retained deployment shows; determinism check passes.

Runtime selection confirms the rebuilt artifacts are used: DeepGEMM resolved from vllm.third_party.deep_gemm with PDL and E8M0 enabled, DEEPGEMM_MXFP4 MoE backend, DeepGemmFP4Experts, and the B12xMxfp8GemmRunner on mxfp8_gemm shapes.
self_build.not_validated_by_this: The SGLang engine, the VM100 deployment, and the published benchmark aggregates are unchanged by this rebuild.

historical_deployment.ext_image: dsv41-vllm-ext:sm120 (packaged from a retained fork build export)
historical_deployment.note: Local-only images that the VM100 deployment runs. They are not published and are not required by the self-build path, which produces its own base and extension images.

vllm.flashinfer_pin_note: Aligned with the fork's own requirements pin. The three SM120 patches apply cleanly and the patched source trees are byte-identical between 0.6.18 and 0.6.18.post1, so the self-build adopts the fork's pin instead of overriding it.
vllm.deepgemm_patch_status: Applied by docker/Dockerfile.vllm-ext when building the extension image. Dockerfile.vllm still copies the patch and its build script for standalone base rebuilds but does not apply them.
